source: DEV ONLY: advisories the line manager reads next to OSV in the dev organisation, in OSV's record shape, to invent a CVE on a package of a dev line and watch the line change. Never present in the real backlog. Each record carries its own invented score under database_specific.cvss, the number and the scale, since the line manager makes no number up from a severity word (18 Sept 2026).
